lead_headline: Park Burger's 15-year Highlands run ends today; restaurant tracker added 1 new lead (Bad Ass Coffee in Englewood)

restaurant.blurb: 1 new lead today — Bad Ass Coffee (Englewood, former Starbucks). Closures: Park Burger Highlands (15 years, lease ended).

liquor.blurb: Fourth consecutive zero-application day extends unprecedented filing drought to full work week. Seven-day count remains frozen at 8 applications — 95% below prior week's 152-filing backlog surge. No status updates or removals recorded. Post-clearance baseline now cemented: sporadic single-digit weekly volume replacing June's anomalous triple-digit processing spike. Pattern confirms operational cadence has normalized following database maintenance completion.

reputation.blurb: 86 mentions this week across 16 sources, up 26% from prior week's 68 and marking fourth consecutive week of growth. Instagram dominated at 33 citations (38% share), trailed by Facebook (14), Denver Post (13), Reddit (11). Monday highlights: Alterra ski headquarters relocation report (Building Salt Lake), Fire on the Mountain Central Park expansion (Denver Post), Union Station preservation feature. Week averaged 12.3 mentions/day vs. prior period's 9.7 — strongest sustained pickup since late May. Year-to-date total reaches 1,167 mentions from 111 sources.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled) — cleanest single-day performance in three weeks pushes MTD to −29 (−1.1/day). 90-day net stands at +82. Recent pattern shows volatility easing: after mid-July's spike cancellations (−14 on 7/21), last five days averaged +0.2/day with controlled churn. Yet monthly trajectory remains negative for 28th straight day — July pacing toward worst month since March. YTD +197 (+0.9/day) stable but requires August reversal to sustain annual growth momentum.
